newsitem.title: USA: Kraft Foods to sell Anco food distributor.
newsitem.headline: Kraft Foods to sell Anco food distributor.

text.p: Kraft Foods Inc, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, said Monday it has reached an agreement to sell its Anco Foods distribution company to Schratter Foods, a unit of French specialty cheese maker Bongrain Group.
Anco, headquartered in Fairfield, New Jersey, focuses on distribution of imported and domestic specialty cheeses, including brand names like Jarlsberg, Brie de Meaux, Bousin, Saga and Dairy Crest.
The sales is expected to be completed by June 30, Kraft said.

"The Anco business is a good one, but it is a distribution business and not the best strategic fit for Kraft," Kraft chief executive Robert Morrison said in a news release. "We are focused on building Kraft through the manufacturing and marketing of our own products."
